subject: Post-call recap & next steps — demo kickoff windows, procurement & security
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie@novagrid.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & next steps — demo kickoff windows, procurement & security

Hi Sophie — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery: 

- Objective: Validate Redwood’s inference runtime against NovaGrid’s real-time recommendations workflow (latency target ~150ms P99, token mix attached).
- Success metrics: throughput for 100 req/s, predictable latency, and an operational plan for SSO + audit logging.
- Ask: schedule a 60-minute technical deep dive/demo with platform + security + procurement present so we can align on integration and purchasing path.

Proposed windows (all PT):
- Tue Aug 18 — 10:00–11:00
- Wed Aug 19 — 13:00–14:00
- Thu Aug 20 — 09:00–10:00

Please confirm: (1) which slot works best, (2) who from NovaGrid should join (security, platform, procurement names/emails), and (3) whether you need any pre-read (I attached a short mutual action plan and our SOC 2 summary).

Mina and Karthik are cc’d — Mina will handle security questions and Karthik will cover procurement/licensing flow. I’ll send a calendar invite once we lock a slot.

Attachments: mutual-action-plan.xlsx (stub), redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (stub)

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
log an.wright@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Thanks Logan — great conversation yesterday.

We’re aligned on the objective. I can do Tue Aug 18 at 10:00 PT. Please include:
- Rajiv Shah (Procurement): rajiv.shah@novagrid.com
- Elena Morales (Security): elena.morales@novagrid.com
- Tomas Rivera (Platform): tomas.rivera@novagrid.com (if possible)

Hi Sophie — thanks for looping names, I’ll join Tue Aug 18 at 10:00 PT. I’ll also share a short SSO/network checklist in this thread before the demo — covers SAML IdP metadata, required assertion attributes, and IP ranges for our test gateway.

Quick asks for prep so we can be efficient during the demo:
- Which IdP are you using (Okta/Azure AD/G Suite/other)?
- Any strict egress rules or proxy in front of your test environment?
- Do you plan to evaluate a hosted (Redwood-hosted) endpoint or private (VPC/on-prem) for the pilot?

I’ve attached a short checklist (sso-checklist.md) that covers the above. If Rajiv or Tomas can confirm network contacts, that will help us scope any firewall rules before the session.

Thanks — Mina
Mina Haddad
Security Lead, Integrations | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com

All set — thanks everyone for the quick replies. I’ve locked Tue Aug 18, 10:00–11:00 PT on the calendar and sent a shared invite (calendar-invite.ics attached). Draft agenda:

1) 10:00–10:10 — Introductions & goals (Logan / Sophie)
2) 10:10–10:35 — Live technical demo and integration model (Mina + Tomas)
3) 10:35–10:50 — Security & SSO details (Mina + Elena)
4) 10:50–11:00 — Procurement path & next steps (Karthik + Rajiv)

Prep notes for NovaGrid: please share your IdP metadata (if available) and any test IP ranges. We’ll demo a hosted endpoint by default and call out the private/VPC options in the procurement section.

Links / resources: mutual action plan (in original attach), SOC 2 summary, sso-checklist.md (attached).

If anything changes, reply-all and we’ll adjust. Looking forward to it.
